notes: Generators bring the lights back after the blackout.
Fuel cans and fuses in garages, sheds and cars.
Food that is going off or spoiled is tinted in the inventory.
Loud or long noises draw zombies from far away.
Zombies see less in the dark, in rain, in snow and in fog.
Clothes get wet in rain and water, and dry slowly.
Firewood from trees, and a wood stove to warm and dry a room.
Fixed floating furniture at the Lundford start and a car sunk in the road.
A radio in Haldersfield picks up a broadcast.
A locked storeroom at the water works.
Build a storage chest that keeps your things.
Build a bed and wake beside it after you die.
Board up windows and doors; zombies can break through.
Felled trees near your camp grow back when nobody is looking.
Basements and dry ditches no longer soak you as if you were in the sea.
Fixed a stutter when the first zombies appear in a new world.
Chests, beds, stoves and fires can no longer be placed inside each other or on furniture.
Placing things indoors works in more spots.
Carried chests, beds and boards no longer block the view.
Haldersfield has a new layout: side lanes, a small square and some houses with their gable to the road.
A footbridge crosses the river by Haldersfield.
The Haldersfield start is further south, with a track into the village.
A second village, Lundford, by the ford: a shop, a co-op, market stalls and a footbridge.
Woodsheds and tool sheds no longer stand in front of back doors.
Fixed a back porch where a workbench blocked the way to the door.
